ideas.pitch: An IoT and AI-driven campus energy management dashboard designed specifically for large engineering institutions like Dr. D. Y. Patil Institute of Technology to track and optimize power consumption across buildings.
ideas.title: CampusFlow: Smart Infrastructure & Energy Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a pain familiar to the college administration and judges evaluating local campus utility costs, combined with a working live dashboard demo.

ideas.pitch: A hyper-local professional networking and skill-mapping platform connecting current students with college alumni for targeted career guidance and real-time portfolio reviews.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an acute pain point for students attending a technical institution looking for placement guidance, matching patterns of high-utility developer and community tools.

ideas.title: MediTriage: Multilingual Campus First-Aid Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles practical student health and safety needs on a busy campus with a smooth, highly polished UI that works seamlessly during live judging.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered garbage classification prototype built with computer vision and simulation code to help optimize dry and wet waste recycling processes in college canteens.
